g.title: G
cluster_micro
cluster_meso
cluster_macro

p1_micro_new_exposure_flag → p1_meso_band_hazard_dispersion upward If new exposures concentrate in some age bands, between-band exposure hazards diverge, increasing cross-band dispersion even when total exposure activity is unchanged.

p1_meso_band_exposure_hazard → p1_micro_new_exposure_flag downward A higher exposure hazard in an age band raises the per-agent probability that a susceptible member of that band transitions from not exposed to exposed at the next observed step, so band-level hazard can drive individual new-exposure events.

p1_meso_band_attack_ratio → p1_micro_new_exposure_flag downward A higher cumulative attack ratio in an age band depletes susceptibles, which lowers the per-susceptible exposure hazard; an individual in that band is therefore less likely to show a new exposure transition.

p1_meso_band_attack_ratio → p1_meso_band_exposure_hazard intra_scale A higher cumulative attack ratio in an age band depletes susceptible members and can lower the band's subsequent exposure hazard per susceptible person-step.

p1_meso_band_attack_ratio → p1_meso_band_hazard_dispersion intra_scale Unequal cumulative attack across bands can widen or narrow cross-band hazard dispersion as susceptible depletion differs by band.

p1_meso_band_hazard_dispersion → p1_micro_new_exposure_flag downward Cross-band inequality in exposure hazard can concentrate exposure pressure on agents in high-hazard age bands, making an individual new-exposure transition more plausible for those agents.

p1_meso_band_hazard_dispersion → p1_micro_ever_exposed_state downward Sustained dispersion of band-level hazard can make some agents accumulate exposure earlier and more often, changing their cumulative ever-exposed state.

p1_meso_band_hazard_dispersion → p1_meso_band_attack_ratio intra_scale Unequal exposure hazard across age bands can generate divergent cumulative attack ratios, with high-hazard bands accumulating more infections.

p1_macro_band_attack_range → p1_meso_band_hazard_dispersion downward A wide cross-age range in cumulative attack can signal uneven depletion and behavioural adaptation across age bands, which can reshape how exposure hazard is dispersed among bands in later steps rather than merely restating the aggregate range.

p1_macro_band_attack_range → p1_macro_band_composition_mismatch intra_scale A wide spread in age-band attack ratios plausibly accompanies a mismatch between the age distribution of exposures and susceptible person-time.

p1_macro_band_composition_mismatch → p1_meso_band_exposure_hazard downward When exposure shares are misaligned with susceptible person-time, exposure pressure is disproportionately borne by bands with more remaining susceptible person-time; this can elevate the measured hazard in those bands as susceptible depletion and exposure targeting co-evolve.

N1 | p1_micro_new_exposure_flag Agent new-exposure transition indicator Scale: micro | Phenomenon: age_structured_incidence_divergence Definition: X_i(t) = 1 if exposed_i(t) = true and exposed_i(t-1) = false, otherwise 0; defined only when agent i is observed at both step t and the immediately preceding observed step t-1 in the same run; undefined if either observation is missing. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N2 | p1_micro_ever_exposed_state Agent cumulative ever-exposed indicator Scale: micro | Phenomenon: age_structured_incidence_divergence Definition: E_i(t) = max over observed steps s <= t in the same run of X_i(s), where X is the new-exposure transition indicator; E_i(t) = 1 if any such s has X_i(s) = 1, else 0; undefined if agent i is not observed at step t. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N3 | p1_meso_band_exposure_hazard Age-band exposure hazard per susceptible person-step Scale: meso | Phenomenon: age_structured_incidence_divergence Definition: h_b(t) = sum over agents i in band b of X_i(t) divided by sum over agents i in band b of S_i(t-1), where S_i(t-1) = susceptible_i(t-1) as a 0/1 quantity; undefined when the denominator is 0 or when t-1 is not observed. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N4 | p1_meso_band_attack_ratio Age-band cumulative attack ratio Scale: meso | Phenomenon: age_structured_incidence_divergence Definition: A_b(t) = count of agents i in band b with E_i(t) = 1 divided by count of agents i in band b observed in at least one step s <= t; undefined when the denominator is 0. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N5 | p1_meso_band_hazard_dispersion Cross-band dispersion of exposure hazard Scale: meso | Phenomenon: age_structured_incidence_divergence Definition: CV(t) = SD_b(h_b(t)) / mean_b(h_b(t)), with the standard deviation and mean taken over bands b whose hazard h_b(t) is defined; undefined when fewer than two bands are defined or when the mean is 0. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N6 | p1_macro_band_attack_range Age-band attack ratio range Scale: macro | Phenomenon: age_structured_incidence_divergence Definition: R(t) = max_b A_b(t) - min_b A_b(t) over bands with defined A_b(t); undefined when fewer than two bands are defined. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N7 | p1_macro_band_composition_mismatch Exposure-share versus susceptible-person-time mismatch Scale: macro | Phenomenon: age_structured_incidence_divergence Definition: M(t) = 0.5 * sum over bands b of |e_b(t) - s_b(t)|, where e_b(t) is the band share of new exposure transitions at t and s_b(t) is the band share of susceptible person-steps at t; undefined when either total is 0.
